title: Okabe and Banana Trees
statementMd:
Okabe needs bananas for one of his experiments for some strange reason. So he decides to go to the forest and cut banana trees.

Consider the point $(*x*, *y*)$ in the 2D plane such that $*x*$ and $*y*$ are integers and $0 ≤ *x*, *y*$. There is a tree in such a point, and it has $*x* + *y*$ bananas. There are no trees nor bananas in other points. Now, Okabe draws a line with equation ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b74e7ae6b32b844d2c16345079d90341beaa131.png). Okabe can select a single rectangle with axis aligned sides with all points on or under the line and cut all the trees in all points that are inside or on the border of this rectangle and take their bananas. Okabe's rectangle can be degenerate; that is, it can be a line segment or even a point.

Help Okabe and find the maximum number of bananas he can get if he chooses the rectangle wisely.

Okabe is sure that the answer does not exceed $10^{18}$. You can trust him.

## Input

The first line of input contains two space-separated integers $*m*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1000$, $1 ≤ *b* ≤ 10000$).

## Output

Print the maximum number of bananas Okabe can get from the trees he cuts.

## Note

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4332070c474c92227eb148520525b2a2a305d8c7.png)

The graph above corresponds to sample test 1. The optimal rectangle is shown in red and has $30$ bananas.
statementZhMd:
由于某种奇怪的原因，冈部需要香蕉来进行他的某项实验。因此，他决定前往森林砍伐香蕉树。

考虑二维平面上的点 $(*x*, *y*)$，其中 $*x*$ 和 $*y*$ 都是整数，且满足 $0 ≤ *x*, *y*$。每个这样的点上都有一棵树，树上有 $*x* + *y*$ 根香蕉。其他点上既没有树，也没有香蕉。现在，冈部绘制了一条方程为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b74e7ae6b32b844d2c16345079d90341beaa131.png) 的直线。冈部可以选择一个边与坐标轴平行的矩形，使其所有点都位于该直线的下方或直线上，然后砍伐矩形内部或边界上的所有点处的树，并拿走树上的香蕉。冈部选择的矩形可以是退化的，也就是说，它可以是一条线段，甚至可以是一个点。

请帮助冈部求出：如果他明智地选择矩形，最多可以获得多少根香蕉。

冈部确信答案不会超过 $10^{18}$。你可以相信他。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*m*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 1000$，$1 ≤ *b* ≤ 10000$）。

## 输出格式

输出冈部砍伐树木后最多可以获得的香蕉数量。

## 说明

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4332070c474c92227eb148520525b2a2a305d8c7.png)

上图对应样例测试 1。最优矩形用红色表示，其中共有 $30$ 根香蕉。
